row.proto: bool Game_SaveMgr_RequestProfileSave_Thunk(void *save_mgr, void *callback, uint8_t a3, uint8_t a4)
row.notes: jmp thunk to .data1 body 0x150bf28c0 (SaveProfile request; body read on Steam). Game_SaveMgr_CreateSaveJob(save_mgr+0x38, 1, 0, 'profile', a3, ...), job+0x11 = a4, copies callback {fn, ctx} (16 bytes) into the request, sends it on g_Game_MessageBus+8 with 0x14302c320 and, when that returns nonzero, starts the job (job vt+0) and queues it on save_mgr+0x60 (vt+0x38). save_mgr = systems map [g_Game_Manager+0x30]: idx = 0x14030ffd0(map, &key) with key = (void*)0x146100ca8, value = [[map+0x18] + idx*0x10 + 8]. Callers pass (mgr, &{0,0}, 1, 0) (Team HQ advance end 0x1422c6dda) or a completion callback {Game_CareerOnlineSynchroniser_OnProfileSaveComplete, this} (career data sync 0x140ff859b). About 40 callers. ts-v1 signature for the test agent (V1494 agree)

verify.notes: V1494 ts-v1 re-read: thunk to the .data1 request body; (save_mgr, {fn,ctx}*, a3, a4) returns true when the bus refused it (iVar4==0), copies the 16-byte callback, null callbacks are what Team HQ's own autosave passes. save_mgr is the value in the game manager's systems map keyed by the address 0x146100ca8 (map find 0x14030ffd0 is a flat hash map: hit returns the slot, miss returns the capacity (ctrl-array minus entries)>>4; entries {key,value} 0x10 bytes from [map+0x18]). Agrees.
